_comment: The AI model registry: what we may call, how to address it, and what it costs. AI_AND_COMMERCE_ARCHITECTURE.md §A.2/§A.7. Ships WITH the code on purpose -- the fee table went stale for three weeks because the deployed S3 config silently outranked the code default (plans/TODO.md, 'the DEPLOYED fee table was three weeks stale'), so this has exactly one source and travels with the deploy that uses it.
_rates_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, AUTHORITATIVE -- read from the model's own Marketplace rate card via bedrock list-foundation-model-agreement-offers, which is where Bedrock pricing actually lives. The AWS Pricing API does NOT have it: all 1052 us-west-2 records carry zero current-generation models, and the pricing page lists the models without rates. Refresh with tools/refresh_ai_rates.py.
_id_comment: `profile` is an inference-profile id, never a bare model id: us-west-2 offers no In-Region inference for this generation, so `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` fails where `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` works.

sonnet-4.6.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
sonnet-4.6.notes: Best measured result for page composition: richest output and the most careful hedging on facts it was not given. EOL no sooner than 2027-02-17.

sonnet-4.5.label: Claude Sonnet 4.5
sonnet-4.5.notes: Fewer sections than 4.6 and volunteered an invented cancellation term. Kept as a fallback, not a default.

opus-4.6.label: Claude Opus 4.6
opus-4.6.notes: 1.6x Sonnet 4.6 for no measured gain on this task, and it invented a cancellation term too. Not for page-gen.

haiku-4.5.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
haiku-4.5.notes: BARRED from page generation (§A.7): cheapest and the only model that drifted on facts -- turned a given '5g per serving' into '5g per gummy', added a taste claim and an efficacy claim. Fine for classification or extraction where nothing is asserted to a buyer.

_scope_comment: `profile` is a GLOBAL inference profile (decided 2026-09-27). Every model costs exactly 10% more on a regional (us.) profile than on a global one -- measured across all 15 models, no exceptions -- and a page-composition prompt carries tenant product copy, never customer PII, so there is nothing here that needs to stay in one geography. `profile_regional` is kept for a tenant or region that later needs US-only routing. Note us-west-2 serves NO In-Region inference for this generation, so a bare model id fails either way.

_rate_source.dimension_note: newer models use *_input_tokens_global_standard; models predating 2026-09 use AFS1_InputTokenCount_Global. Both are handled.

unavailable._comment: Rates are real; availability is not. These have model agreements reporting AVAILABLE on all four Bedrock flags (agreement, entitlement, authorization, region) and converse still returns AccessDenied -- in us-west-2 and us-east-1, hours later. PROVEN ORTHOGONAL 2026-09-27: deleting sonnet-4.5's agreement left it invoking perfectly (NOT_AVAILABLE + works), while these sit at AVAILABLE + denied. So create_foundation_model_agreement is NOT what grants access; entitlement is granted elsewhere and appears to need AWS approval (the error's own advice is 'contact AWS Sales', and put_use_case_for_model_access exists as a separate reviewed submission). Nothing here is selectable until an invocation proves otherwise.
